definitions.short: properly, to hammer out (an edge), i.e. to sharpen
definitions.full: H3913. latash [ לָטַשׁ ] verb hammer, sharpen, whet (Late Hebrew id., hammer, tap ; Aramaic לְטַשׁ , sharpen ; Arabic strike, tap); — Qal Imperfect יִלְטוֺשׁ Job 16:9 ; Psa 7:13 ; Infinitive construct לֵלְטוֺשׁ 1Sam 13:20 ; Participle לֹטֵשׁ ; — 1 hammer , only Participle = hammerer followed by כָּלתֹֿרֵשׁ Gen 4:22 (J). 2 sharpen sword חֶרֶב (accusative) Psa 7:13 ; compare 1Sam 13:20 , object מַחֲרֵשָׁה קַרְדֹּם, אֵת, מַחֲרֶשֶׁת, ; figurative ׳ל לִי עֵינַיִם Job 16:9 my foe whets his eye for me Pu`al Participle מְלֻטָּשׁ תַּעַר Psa 52:4 a sharpened razor (in simile of evil tongue).
